exact_review_message: Full-suite package verdict: REPAIR REQUIRED before GO. Medium finding: the command inherits ambient `PYTHONOPTIMIZE`, while `run_job.py:32-36,55` copies it into the child; `full_suite_command_v2.json:7-29,39-53` neither clears/binds it; and `run_full_suite_v2.py:68-75,124-126` checks version/safe_path but neither requires nor records `sys.flags.optimize == 0`. Reproduction: launch the prepared command from an environment with `PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1`; both Python processes start optimized despite absence of `-O`, preflight accepts it because the variable is absent from freeze.environment, and application asserts are removed. The candidate contains 9 runtime asserts under `semabi/`, so this can change exercised semantics and can yield unsupported success evidence. Smallest repair: have the entrypoint fail closed on `sys.flags.optimize != 0` and record `optimize`; bind that revised entrypoint/freeze/command. Clearing `PYTHONOPTIMIZE` in the outer command as defense in depth is also appropriate. Everything else examined passed: freeze identity/membership and 2878+170 hashes, exact 70-test discovery/config surface, committed/clean HEAD, helper authentication before compilation, Python/package anchors, no-pyc prefix, pytest args/plugin metadata, output reservation, postflight revalidation, and command round-trip.

root_direction: Use explicit PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 in command environment and preflight; require and record sys.flags.optimize==0. Retain already-created archived-v2 revision scheme. Targeted delta review only.
